Items before: a milky tea/coffee (latte-style mug, ~ 200 mL with milk, ~40 kcal), a savory muffin (bacon and cheese, ~ 90 g, ~250 kcal), a slice of sourdough bread (~70 g, ~180 kcal), 2 butter/spread portions (~10 g each, ~70 kcal each if butter; ~140 kcal total), and a yoghurt cup (~170 g, ~150 kcal).

After: the mug is empty, the muffin is eaten (only the wrapper remains), the bread is gone, the yoghurt is eaten, and one butter portion is used (the foil is visible, with the other tub partly used). The two tubs remain, one with a little residue, so roughly 1.5 portions were eaten. The wrapper on the plate is the yoghurt lid.

Energy:
- Tea with milk: 40 kcal
- Muffin: 250 kcal
- Bread: 180 kcal
- Butter, about 1.5 portions at 7 g each (≈10 g, 75 kcal)
- Yoghurt: 150 kcal

Total ≈ 695 kcal, which I'll round to 700.

Mass: tea 220 + muffin 90 + bread 70 + butter 10 + yoghurt 170 = 560 g.
